top_signals.title: Guyana Oil Boom Rekindles Frontier Drilling Appetite
top_signals.summary: Exxon announced this week that total oil production in Guyana had topped 1 million barrels. Guyana’s transformation into a formidable oil power is now motivating other oil majors to seek opportunities to replicate Exxon’s story. It is quite easy to see why. Exxon, along with its partners Hess Corp. and CNOOC, spent billions on developing the Stabroek Block offshore the tiny South American country. top_signals.title: 7,000 Egyptian Factories Will Soon Be Solar-powered
top_signals.summary: Egypt is rapidly expanding its solar power capacity as part of its goal to source 42% of its electricity from renewables by 2030 and 65% by 2040. The country currently gets most of its energy from fossil fuels, primarily natural gas and petroleum, which account for roughly 87% of Egypt's electricity generation. Renewables make up around 13%, divided between 6% hydropower and 7% wind and solar. Egypt’s solar PV capacity is projected to grow from roughly 2.9 GW to 34.3 GW by 2035, driving total national renewable capacity toward nearly 49.7…
